I did as I’m told as fowarded her with the information. I got home, took the prescribed medicine and fell asleep. I was shocked when I woke up to find my phone with 2 miscalled and 30 new messages from her giving me work to do from home. I felt it was a little bit unfair of her to give me work while I’m on a sick leave and so I ignored the message and didn’t reply her. So, AITA for not replying her text? Notes: English is not my first language, I’m sorry if there’s a lot of grammatical errors.
